title: Understanding Car-Speak: Replacing Humans in Dealerships
answer_short: Labels in the car-speak language dataset map abstract car-speak terms to specific car models or physical attributes.
answer_rationale: The car-speak dataset is built by mapping abstract car-speak terms (e.g., 'fast') to specific car models or physical attributes (e.g., horsepower or form factor) as derived from car reviews tied to concrete vehicles. This mapping is explicitly supported by Text 1, which defines car-speak as abstract language pertaining to physical attributes, and Text 3, which states that reviews are written about specific cars and thus allow mapping car-speak to specific models. Text 20 further clarifies that car-speak terms like 'fast' refer to physical attributes, reinforcing the mapping.
